data.sampling: Exact weighted support enumeration in every group; only the eight reference tails are sampled independently.
limitations: Empirical certificate only: B=max(Z)-min(Z) over eight groups is not a proven support range.
Curvatures are unpadded ray searches/CRN second differences, not certified global suprema.
delta=.05 is nominal per state and per h; h selection is not a simultaneous three-h confidence guarantee.
Short-tail calibration uses actual full-tail gold, not an unbiased oracle first-order target; transfer to holdouts is unproved.
Threshold objectives are ineligible. Calibration uses separately executed warm3/warm7 snapshots and only the pilot recipes/tasks.
Scores reuse evaluations across pairs and split duplicates; costs count actual unique-cell executions.
The 1016 comparator uses M=4; the panel has M=8 and needs 1154 at the same Hoeffding settings.

checks.asserted: Theorem 5.3: finite CRN replacements; no wrong aligned a-priori certificates

data.sampling: Exact law-weighted terminal outcomes after each actual support-atom increment; one IID reference tail per replica shared across all candidates.

costs.reuse: r=64 is the first 64 of 256 IID replicas; splits and pairs reuse each unique cell. Independent-tail diagnostics are extra executions. No curvature or gradient overhead.

limitations: A-priori empirical Bernstein is simultaneous over candidate pairs at ONE fixed state/r/surrogate; not jointly over all states or both r values.
Observed B is a diagnostic, not a known support bound or guaranteed certificate.
Short alignment is a calibration residual envelope; transfer to held-out states is assumed, not proved.
Threshold objectives are bounded and eligible here; matched C6/E12 subsets exclude them.
Zero certified wrong signs is vacuous whenever coverage is zero.
Split duplicates are retained in tables, not counted as extra independent states.
The comparator is C6's recorded 1016 tails/candidate (M=4); M=8 requires 1154.

scope: Synthetic numerical instances only; K counts independent synthetic demonstrations, not real trajectories. No training or benchmark claims.
